preprocessing: OneHotEncoder on source, passthrough on boolean features
exclusions: stage = 'Junk' AND junk_reason_id IS NULL (junk stage with no recorded reason) — 158 rows
trained_on: 446 leads (80% stratified train split; test on the held-out 112)
metrics_note: Model retrained from scratch on crm.db via train_model.py using the author's exact 4-feature derivation (has_campaign/has_quiz_answers parsed from touchpoint raw_payload, matched_at_intake from system-ingested (actor_id IS NULL) create audit events, source label or 'none') and training-set exclusions (terminal_type='bot': 79; 'Junk' stage with null junk_reason_id: 158), leaving 558 of 795 leads. Fit on an 80/20 stratified split (random_state=42); train_accuracy is on the 446 train rows, test_accuracy and precision/recall/f1 are on the held-out 112 test rows, full_accuracy is over all 558 (includes train rows, so optimistic). Retrained under scikit-learn 1.9.0.
